name: plugin_packs_validate_config_seed
notes: Config-seed validation (REAL port src/hermes_cli/plugin_packs_pure.c::plugin_pack_validate_config_seed linked into the harness vs LIVE hermes_cli/plugin_packs.py::validate_config_seed). Verdict strings come from the real port; branch events mirror its ladder. Covers: valid dicts, empty dict, non-mapping seeds, reserved consent keys, allow_* trust gates, secret-shaped keys (case-insensitive), multi-key passes, stop-on-first-rejection ordering. EXCLUDED inputs (documented divergences): empty-string key (LIVE rejects with {key!r} quoting, C prints it raw) and 'apikey'/'privatekey' unseparated spellings (LIVE regex api[_-]?key matches them, C token list only has api_key/api-key - real port gap worth a follow-up).
